work_elements.name: VITA HEALTH
work_elements.description: Maintained and optimized a legacy PHP and MySQL backend, subsequently migrating the infrastructure to AWS EC2 and shifting core services to a Node.js and TypeScript stack. Refactored the database architecture from DynamoDB to PostgreSQL to enhance data structure and system maintainability. Built CI/CD pipelines, documented system architecture, and modularized the codebase for improved scalability. Developed complex algorithms specifically for personalized diet and workout generation.

work_elements.name: FINANZA.TECH
work_elements.description: Developed the public portal and internal administration system, managing product purchase flows and Stripe integrations. I designed advanced algorithms to parse company reports and automatically reconstruct complex corporate structures, entity networks, and beneficial ownerships, constantly balancing fast delivery with deep technical adaptability across multiple stack layers.

work_elements.name: BITVAVO
work_elements.description: Acted as the ultimate technical escalation point, performing high-stakes, live troubleshooting and debugging on mission-critical AWS Lambda transaction pipelines. Spearheaded the architectural design and implementation of distributed microservices, ensuring high availability, security, and systemic scalability. Engineered the core administration panel for the support team and architected a robust, multilevel RBAC authorization system to secure internal operations. Authored, published, and maintained the open-source nest-yalc library, driving code standardization and efficiency across multiple R&D projects.

work_elements.name: FREELANCING
work_elements.description: Delivered end-to-end full-stack solutions across multiple independent projects, including e-commerce systems, a desktop launcher (Azeroth Shard), custom CMS modules, and comprehensive B2C web applications. Managed all project phases from structural analysis to the implementation of interactive frontends (React, Angular) and robust backends. Integrated external tools and APIs, such as Google Maps and payment gateways, while resolving critical server-side and client-side bugs to ensure high performance.
